release_notes:
BSF-INTEL Version 2.0.2 Release.
- NEW: Premium dashboard UI featuring sleek KPI cards and rounded icon badges.
- NEW: Complete linear gradient styling supporting reactive hover elevations on both Light and Dark themes.
- NEW: Transitioned dashboard widgets from mock simulation loops to a live, event-driven Modbus telemetry pipeline.
- NEW: Calculated real-time physical telemetry indicators (spindle loads, friction temperature, vibration variance) directly from live PLC/VFD signals.
- FIX: Automatic alert triggers on force standard deviation and VFD rated power thresholds.
